$comment: The phone-gyro mirror's device-to-controller axis remap, run by the Apple DeviceGyroVectorTests and the Android DeviceGyroVectorTest. Sensors report in the natural-portrait frame (+x right edge, +y top, +z out of the screen); the wire wants the frame the player sees (x right, y up, z out of the screen). `pose` is where the device's top points as the player sees it: up is portrait, down is upside down, left and right are the two landscape turns. A rotation rate and an acceleration remap the same way, and z never changes. Each remap row is `input` -> `expect` as [x, y, z]. `wire_units` are the raw counts per rad/s and per g that both clients scale a sample by (compared within 1e-3).
